title: The X clears the selection and exits, search, filter and sort still work
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Seed a few inventory parts (tag throwaway data "ZZAUTOTEST", e.g. part number "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", name "ZZAUTOTEST package part") via New Inventory Part. Turn Deactivate parts on and tick some rows.
custom_steps:
1. Use search, the filter bar, sorting and paging while the mode is on.
  2. Hover the X at the right of the bar and read the tooltip; then click it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Search, the filter bar, sorting and paging all keep working while the mode is on, the same as in Cycle count.
  • The X (tooltip and screen-reader label "Clear selection") leaves the mode, clears the selection and returns the toolbar to its normal state.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 2 (Deactivate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label. It leaves the mode, clears the selection and returns the toolbar to its normal state.”
  • S2-R10: “Search, the filter bar, sorting and paging all keep working while the mode is on, the same as they do in Cycle count.”
